welcomeMessage.title: 🌌 Welcome to Nullforge Expanse
welcomeMessage.description: Journey into the void and discover the secrets of ancient mechanical civilizations.
welcomeMessage.content:
This is the official Discord server for the **Nullforge Expanse** Minecraft mod.

**What is Nullforge Expanse?**
Nullforge Expanse is a biome-driven expansion that blends cosmic void energy with ancient mechanical structures. Explore floating islands, crystal formations, and ancient ruins as you confront the mysterious Endforged Automaton.

**Features:**
🤖 Unique hostile mobs: Scraplings, Chrono-Stalkers, Void Sentries
⚔️ Combat with voidforged gear and ancient equipment
🏗️ Explore corrupted void landscapes and mechanical temples
🎯 Face the boss: The Endforged Automaton
💎 Craft powerful items and unlock ancient secrets

**Getting Started:**
1. Read #rules
2. Check #announcements for the latest updates
3. Browse #guides-tutorials for installation help
4. Introduce yourself in #introductions
5. Join our voice channels to connect with the community

Have fun exploring the Nullforge Expanse! 🌌

rulesMessage.title: 📜 Server Rules
